listenings.text: Good evening. My name is Mark and I am your waiter tonight. Here is the menu. Tonight we have some very good fish, and the soup of the day is tomato soup with bread. I am sorry, we do not have any oysters today. Would you like some water first, still or sparkling? And would you like to see the wine list? Take your time. I come back in five minutes.

Hi Rodrigo, this is Nora from the New York office. About dinner on Friday. I have a table for two people, at eight o'clock, at the place near your hotel. They have some excellent pasta, and the bread there is very good. They do not have any tables outside in October, so we are inside. One more thing. Service is not in the bill here, so we always leave twenty percent for the waiter. See you on Friday.

extra_audio.text: Rodrigo sat down and the waiter gave him the menu. He read the starters and chose the tomato soup. For the main course he asked for the fish of the day. Then he ordered a glass of wine and a chocolate dessert. At the end he asked for the bill and left twenty percent for the waiter.

paras: STARTERS. Tomato soup with bread — nine dollars. Green salad with cheese — eleven dollars. Six oysters — eighteen dollars.
MAIN COURSES. Grilled chicken with potatoes — twenty-four dollars. Fish of the day with rice — twenty-nine dollars. Pasta with tomato sauce — twenty-one dollars.
DESSERTS. Chocolate cake — nine dollars. Ice cream, two scoops — seven dollars. Fruit of the season — eight dollars.
DRINKS. Water, still or sparkling — five dollars. Wine by the glass — from fourteen dollars. Coffee — four dollars. Sorry, we do not have any beer today.
The kitchen is open from six to eleven, every day. We have some tables outside. Service is not in the bill: in New York, fifteen to twenty percent is normal.
